name: Eirwyn Valkstorm
passives: Oathbound — Eirwyn's Mastery: Eirwyn's Storm Oath: a solo range aperture that grows when the Titan uses movement through storm lanes to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Eirwyn Valkstorm is a colossal Asgardian breaker from The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Asgardian breaker office: judgement rupture, armor sundering, trial by force; Valhalla/einherjar: honored dead, feast before final war.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Eirwyn Valkstorm shows storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.. Role silhouette must read as Breaker. Materials include dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur, raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor, glowing UI runes, blocky hammer mech.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Eirwyn Sundering Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Storm damage at range 2; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from storm-marked terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Oath Armor Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Apply armor break, shield collapse, boss phase pressure; also builds 10 Oathstorm when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Eirwyn Valkstorm: Gatebreaker Decree
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Oathstorm to create a two-round battlefield rule around storm-marked terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Oath Storm Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Oathstorm, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Runebound Oath Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +4 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Eirwyn Valkstorm Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Eirwyn Oathstorm Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Oathstorm cap +20. At 80+ Oathstorm, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Oathstorm.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
